finalText:
Migration finished. 12 files still called `db.query` and all now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`, matching the pattern already used elsewhere.

Files updated: `cohort.js`, `returnService.js`, `shipment.js`, `refund.js`, `couponService.js`, `macroAdmin.js`, `sla.js`, `variantAdmin.js`, `supplier.js`, `teamService.js`, `apiKeyAdmin.js`, `session.js`.

One file still uses `db.query`: `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js`. I left it alone — its header says it's a vendored copy, replaced wholesale on upgrades, and local edits get silently lost.

All 12 edited files pass `node --check`. Since `db.query` in `lib/db.js` stays functional (just deprecated), nothing breaks in the meantime.
